description:
List all memories with a specific tag.

Common uses:
- Inspect a memory-driven scheduling wake-up: when a schedule fires with memory_tag=X, the platform retrieves memories tagged with X and presents them as an observation at process_results.
- Inspect follow-up queues (e.g., followup_queue:global) and queued check-in instructions.
- Audit or clean up tagged memories before deletion.

This is read-only; it helps you understand what follow-up instructions or queued work exist for a given tag.
embedding_description: List memories matching a tag. Use to inspect memory-driven scheduling wake-ups (memory_tag), follow-up queues (followup_queue:*), and heartbeat instruction memories (heartbeat:global). Read-only introspection before cleanup or rescheduling.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: List of memories matching the specified tag
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Memories matching the tag were retrieved. If this tag is used as a wake-up instruction, read the content to decide what to do next (post a check-in, check job status, reschedule, or clean up completed items). If you expected a memory but none exist, you may need to remember/upsert the instructions for that tag.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Listing memories with a specific tag
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: DatabaseError: failed to query memory records.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For database errors: verify state storage is accessible.
